name: application-production-line-status
title: Production Line Status
description: A manufacturing line overview with per-station tiles showing run state (running/fault/stopped), live throughput vs target, and a fault/below-target summary.
useWhen: Manufacturing or plant-floor dashboards need to show each station's run state alongside a quantitative throughput number and target comparison.
Operators need to spot faults and below-target stations at a glance across a fixed line of stations.
avoidWhen: Monitoring uptime/status of software services rather than physical stations — `Health Check Grid`'s ping-dot service list fits that shape better.
Stations don't have a meaningful units/hour throughput metric — a simpler status badge list is enough.
responsiveBehavior: Station tiles sit in a 3-column grid at the card's max width; each tile's content stacks vertically regardless of column count.
accessibility: Each station's run state is stated as visible text (Running, Fault: sensor E-04, Stopped, Below target) in addition to the status dot color, so status is never conveyed by color alone.
The fault station's tile uses both a red border/background and red text, giving redundant, non-color-only signaling for colorblind users.
The footer summary restates the fault and below-target counts as text for quick scanning without reading every tile.

variants.title: Assembly line 4 stations
variants.description: A 6-station assembly line grid with a header throughput badge, per-station tiles showing running (with live-ping dot)/fault/below-target/stopped states, units-per-hour with target comparison, and a footer fault/below-target summary.
accessibility: Each station's state is stated as text; the fault tile uses both color and text to signal severity.

variants.title: Assembly line 4 stations (Dark)
variants.description: Production line status adapted for dark surfaces, including fault/warning tile backgrounds and status dot colors.
accessibility: Station names, throughput numbers, and status text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
